newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate falls, baht firmer late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate falls, baht firmer late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate dropped to 10.50 percent in late trade on Tuesday from 10.75-11.00 early as continued selling of the dollar for baht helped raise liquidity, dealers said.
"The interbank rate may ease slightly tomorrow. But there will be strong support at the 10.00 percent," said one dealer at a foreign bank.

The baht rose to 25.635-25.645 against the dollar near the close from 25.646-25.649 in morning trade as the dollar's weakness against the yen prompted continued selling of the U.S. unit, dealers said.
"The overall trade was quite active today with more selling of the dollar following the U.S. currency's fall abroad," said another dealer.
The baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 8.50/9.00 satangs per dollar late compared with 9.00/9.50 earlier.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar mid-rate at 25.66 against 25.65 on Monday.
